about: Two agents plan a school trip to Prague. The researcher uses five tools (the clock, Wikipedia, the weather, a search in a price list, the notes) and the writer two (the calculator and the word counter). One run, all seven tools. Anthropic (paid).
how: Each agent is given only the tools it needs. The researcher gathers the facts with five tool calls and passes them on; the writer works out the total cost with the calculator, checks the length with the counter and writes the final text.
learns: A model chooses the right tool for each part of a task: a clock, a lookup, a search in documents, a calculator and a counter, in one run.
watch: Which tool answers which part of the task, how the next Friday follows from the clock, and the total cost from the calculator.
